Contract:
Rendered by the CALLING step's final step, after its artifact is written and verified. Shape:
1. One ✅ line — what was produced and what was checked (`✅ Спека записана · язык проверен · диаграмм`). 2. `**Что дальше?**` + one `AskUserQuestion` call. Options (2–4) come from the caller's own candidate table; CHAINED options are first-class («декомпозиция + критик следом», «scaffold + сразу execute») — one pick launches the whole chain, the agent runs it without stopping between links unless a link fails. Ordering and content, while ANY scope in the Scope Graph still lacks a spec: the recommended option is ALWAYS «Продолжить спеки: discovery `<следующий скоуп по графу зависимостей>`» (the next unspec'd scope in dependency order), marked «(рекомендую)» — spec authoring stays the priority path while it is incomplete. The scaffold option is included ONLY once no scope remains without a spec, and never marked recommended over an outstanding spec — its description states the rationale plainly: «Разбить готовые спеки на задачи (scaffold) — механическая нарезка утверждённых спек в тикеты DAG; рекомендуется после готовности всех спек». The two are never interleaved as equals: specs demand the operator's sustained attention on judgment calls (vision, scope boundaries, trade-offs); scaffold is mechanical decomposition of what is already approved — surfacing scaffold beside an incomplete spec set invites the operator to jump to the mechanical step before the judgment work is done. «Закончить сессию» is always last; on pick, print a short resume instruction (how to reopen this flow next session — which command/skill, which scope or step to name) and stop; no directive loads. 3. On any other pick: invoke the corresponding skill(s) / directive flow(s) directly — never answer with «запусти /sdd-X сам».
